name: Shadha Shareef
tagline: Full Stack Developer & Creative Problem Solver
bio: I am an aspiring developer with a keen eye for design and a drive to create innovative solutions, combining logic and creativity to build clean, responsive interfaces. Outside of coding, I enjoy learning new technologies, experimenting with tools, and exploring ideas to understand how things work. I focus on writing clean, maintainable code and continually improving my skills.

projects.title: Edusphere Plus
projects.desc: A Java-based learning platform where students and teachers can upload and access notes, videos, and quizzes. Users can search content by subject, rate and comment on it, and take practice quizzes.

projects.title: Career Recommendation System
projects.desc: A machine learning system that evaluates how well a candidate's resume matches a given job description by analyzing skills, experience, and keywords to compute an eligibility score and highlight gaps.

projects.title: StreetSpeak
projects.desc: A citizen-driven platform for reporting road and transportation issues with location and media support, enabling transparent issue tracking and resolution by authorities.

projects.title: EQShare
projects.desc: A math-driven collaboration platform that ensures fair workload distribution in group projects by modeling task complexity, urgency, and individual contribution through explainable metrics.

projects.title: Swipe in the Wild
projects.desc: A playful, forest-themed swipe experience inspired by dating apps and reimagined in cozy pixel art, with quirky animal characters and a light narrative.
